title: Catalytic Species Conversion (A→C via B)
description: Convert A-labeled monomers to C-labeled monomers using B as a catalyst. This is a simplified k-SAT encoding where A represents unsatisfied clauses and C represents satisfied clauses, with B acting as variable flips. Your goal is to maximize the fraction of C molecules while minimizing fuel consumption (flip events).

proposal_context.motivation: Tests basic non-equilibrium fuel-driven computation. Molecular encoding where clause particles (A) change conformation depending on bound variable particles (B), biasing the system toward satisfying assignments.

measurement_perturbation_relaxation.perturbation: Selects variable to flip based on policy

encoding.geometry_description: Single core (excluded volume) with 3 patches (binding sites). Core at origin, patches at (0.5, 0, 0.1), (0.5, 0.087, -0.05), (0.5, -0.087, -0.05).

species.label: core
species.description: Rigid body core atom (excluded volume, unchanging)

species.label: A
species.description: A-labeled patch (initial state, can flip to C when in contact with B)

species.label: C
species.description: C-labeled patch (target state, created by flips)

interactions.description: Only B-A and B-C attract (identical Morse potential). All other pairs neutral or repulsive (core-core).

target.description: Fraction of molecules that are C (satisfied)

scoring.description: Minimize fuel consumed (ΔPE or flip count) per unit of C-yield achieved. Lower is better.

secondary_metrics.name: final_yield
secondary_metrics.description: Final fraction of C molecules at end of simulation

secondary_metrics.name: flip_count
secondary_metrics.description: Total number of state change events (fuel consumption proxy)

secondary_metrics.name: cumulative_work
secondary_metrics.description: Sum of ΔPE between thermo outputs

penalties.description: Simulation timeout (no additional penalty, just stop)
Penalize solutions that barely convert any A to C

forbidden_transitions: B → anything (B is catalyst, must stay B)

tunable_parameters.name: morse_depth_AB
tunable_parameters.description: Morse potential depth for A-B (type 2-3) interaction
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: Binding strength between unsatisfied clause and catalyst

tunable_parameters.name: morse_depth_BC
tunable_parameters.description: Morse potential depth for B-C (type 3-4) interaction
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: Binding strength between satisfied clause and catalyst

tunable_parameters.name: morse_alpha
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: How sharply attraction falls off with distance

tunable_parameters.name: morse_r0
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: Preferred binding distance (0 = patches can overlap)

tunable_parameters.name: contact_cutoff
tunable_parameters.description: Distance threshold for state change trigger
tunable_parameters.physical_meaning: How close patches must be to trigger flip

correctness_checks.description: All B molecules must remain B (catalyst invariant)
No sudden energy spikes (indicates numerical instability)

random_policy.description: Random flip when in contact (no intelligence)

greedy_policy.description: Always flip A→C when touching B, hysteresis=5
